$comment: Desired state for every repository in the organisation.
The reconcile workflow reads this file and makes reality match it.
Adding a repository here is the only step needed to onboard it.
$ownerBypassOnDevelop: REVOKED 2026-08-06. Granted 2026-08-04 for two days; the term has expired and the
flag is now false, so reconcile clears the bypass actors from the develop ruleset.
Kept documented rather than deleted because the underlying constraint has not gone
away and someone will need this reasoning before granting it again.
GitHub has no setting that lets anyone approve their own pull request, and this
organisation has one human, so the sole maintainer could not merge their own work.
This grants the organisation owner a bypass on develop in pull_request mode: a pull
request is still required and direct pushes are still refused, only the approval
NEVER set this for main. A bypass skips every rule in the ruleset, which on main
would discard the code-owner gate that keeps bots out of production.
The Developer App is deliberately NOT a bypass actor, so it still cannot self-merge.
Rulesets have no expiry. Set this back to false; see TODO.txt.

$comment: ci/agent-guard removed from the required checks: the centralised lifecycle now
publishes ai-review and enforces the same invariants, so requiring both meant
running two guards over every pull request. The requirement is dropped BEFORE
agent-guard.yml is deleted - removing the workflow first would leave a required
check nothing can publish and block develop permanently.
